text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Do you hear them, Trainer? They're
calling for
me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
They're all here to see me. To see the
number one
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Do you think... they'll remember me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Am I finally, truly... the number one
Umamusume
of all time?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tears begin to pour from Daiwa Scarlet's
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deafening applause floods the Winner's
Circle,
where Daiwa Scarlet stands the
sole victor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She really is the number one
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All right! That's enough embarrassing
myself.
Everyone's waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You need to hurry up and get ready too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
For the awards ceremony, obviously!
We're going
to be swamped with
interview requests!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You'll need to tell them all about me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Like, "I've trained her all the way to
becoming the
top Umamusume! She's my
pride and joy!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Like, "I've trained her all the way to
becoming the
top Umamusume! She's my
pride and joy!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet takes me by the hand and
leads me
to the awards ceremony.
